product_one_liner.value: Maximum is an AI-native operating system for banks that lets financial institutions deploy custom agents to automate workflows, gain real-time customer insights, and deliver new financial products.

pricing_page.notes: There is no pricing link in the homepage navigation/footer, and /pricing renders the same product marketing page rather than pricing plans.

named_customers.notes: The clients route shows no customer names; the only named bank relationship found is Emprise Bank, described as a design partnership, with its first platform traffic expected later in 2026, not a demonstrated customer case study.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile enrichment reports 11 employees; mapped to the requested band.

hq_location.notes: The LinkedIn company profile identifies Miami as headquarters; Dealroom also lists Miami, United States.

founded_year.notes: Dealroom and PitchBook report 2025; LinkedIn gives 2026, which appears to reflect the public launch year, so 2025 is the best-supported founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The /blog route renders the product marketing homepage rather than a blog index or technical posts; no actual company blog was found.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer have no Docs or Help link, and no public documentation portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists three engineering roles, none with AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision in its title.

model_provider.notes: The public product, security/privacy, blog, and documentation routes reviewed did not identify an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security and legal/privacy pages name none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: Maximum announced the $30 million Seed round on August 3, 2026; no later round was found.

raised_18mo.notes: The announced Seed round closed August 3, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists three engineering roles and no SDR, BDR, sales representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: On August 3, 2026, Maximum emerged from stealth and publicly introduced its AI-native operating system for banks, within the six-month window; product development was still ongoing.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete team page or dated C-level/VP joining or departure record was found; the public team information is insufficient to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job board and all three listed engineering postings name no CRM or sales/marketing system.
